scope.method: Read captured real-agent JSON, artifact requests/responses/events, and replay only TeamDecisionResult.from_grounded_final with captured final text and verified reads. No Provider, RuntimeState, Ledger, or state replay was executed.

taxonomy_contract.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN or NOT_OBSERVED is used where the captured artifacts cannot establish a fact. False is not used as a substitute for missing observation.

code_boundaries.boundary: from_grounded_final calls json.loads(text) and raises the exact ValidationError 'TeamDecisionResult Final is not valid JSON.' on parse failure.
Catches ValidationError from Final parsing/validation and masks it as generic TEAM_DECISION_CONTRACT_ERROR without preserving the subreason.
validate_relation_final checks read-only citations, conflicts, relation direction, and complete-chain coverage; it is downstream of JSON parsing and was not reached by the six malformed Finals.
_parse_function_call rejects a provider tool name absent from request.available_tools as MODEL_RESPONSE_UNSUPPORTED, reason undeclared_tool.
AdapterFailure is converted to a normalized ModelResponse error with diagnostics and RESPONSE_VALIDATION metadata; raw provider shape is not retained in the normalized response file.
A response with no non-empty text and no accepted tool call is classified as MODEL_RESPONSE_MALFORMED, reason empty_action.
ValidationError or any uncaught adapter exception around invoke_model becomes MODEL_ADAPTER_FAILED with only turn_id in the durable error.

host_vs_fake.artifact_transfer_metadata: All 11 cases record host_query=true, read_routing=advisory_only, production_default_changed=false.
host_vs_fake.host_behavior: Search query generation uses the migrated Host relation terms and verified parent entity; read_verified_note calls remain model-initiated.
host_vs_fake.fake_controller_behavior: No captured trace shows FakeController force-Pending-Read behavior. REAL_AGENT_TRANSFER.md:3 says V1 relation_candidates/first_hit modified SourceOnlyController Pending Reads and had no Gemini equivalent; :7 says read priority was advisory only.
host_vs_fake.conclusion: Host query migration is evidenced. FakeController forced-read equivalence is not evidenced and must not be claimed.

root_cause_separation: The six Contract Error cases are one first boundary (Final JSON parsing) but two model-output shapes: four incomplete JSON prefixes and two non-JSON reflection texts.
D11 is a Provider response-validation failure (empty_action after MAX_TOKENS), not a TeamDecision grounding failure.
D21-v1 is an adapter/runtime failure with missing turn-7 response evidence; its underlying exception is UNKNOWN.
D24-v1 is a distinct Gemini SDK parse failure caused by undeclared_tool with zero request tool declarations.
D21 baseline is a valid safe Partial caused by unavailable leader evidence, not a Contract Error.
comparative_findings.harness_observation: The harness preserved raw artifact/request/response hashes and correctly surfaced terminal error codes, but retrieval_agent.py discarded the exact ValidationError message when mapping it to TEAM_DECISION_CONTRACT_ERROR. No Gold mutation or scoring rerun was used in this autopsy.

limitations: For malformed Finals, the partial text cannot prove whether an unrelated or conflict evidence ID would have appeared later; those fields are UNKNOWN.
For D11 and D24-v1, the normalized response contains diagnostics but no raw wire Provider response payload; the reported reason is the captured adapter diagnostic, not an invented payload.
For D21-v1, turn 7 has a request and failure event but no response.json/provider request record; the cause remains UNKNOWN by design.
All claims are based on captured artifacts under the old worktree; this run made no real Gemini call and changed no production or Gold file.
